**`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-surface)`) — Fill of the outer card (`[part="base"]`) while `frame="card"`. `frame="plain"` still removes the fill entirely.
**`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-border)`) — Outline color of the mouse-hover preview on `[part="body"]`.

**`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `calc(-1 * var(--lr-focus-ring-offset))`) — Inward offset of the mouse-hover preview on `[part="body"]`, keeping the outline inside its own scrollport so it is not clipped at the edge.
**`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `solid`) — Outline style of the mouse-hover preview on `[part="body"]`.
**`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-focus-ring-width)`) — Outline width of the mouse-hover preview on `[part="body"]`.
**`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-border)`) — Colour of the outer card's border and of the header/body divider, which `frame="plain"` keeps.
**`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-font-size-sm)`) — Font size of `[part="body"]` while `size` is `s` or smaller.
**`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-space-s)`) — `[part="body"]` padding while `size` is `s` or smaller.
**`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-font-size-sm)`) — Font size of `[part="header"]` while `size` is `s` or smaller.
**`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-space-2xs)`) — Gap between the header toggle, label, and duration while `size` is `s` or smaller.
**`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-space-2xs) var(--lr-space-s)`) — `[part="header"]` padding while `size` is `s` or smaller.
**`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-size-16rem)`) — Cap on how tall the expanded reasoning transcript grows before `[part="body"]` scrolls internally.
**`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Live pending-state color.
**`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-radius)`) — Corner radius of the outer card. `frame="plain"` still squares the corners.

**`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `currentColor`) — Foreground of `<mark>` descendants returned by `renderExcerpt`.
**`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `0`) — Padding of `<mark>` descendants returned by `renderExcerpt`.
**`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-radius-xs)`) — Corner radius of `<mark>` descendants returned by `renderExcerpt`.
